diagnosis: The checks C4 passed in all four rollouts because the lone decision-maker used a default value of 30 days for the 'cure_notice_days' decision, which matches the value specified in PF2. This default value is easily hit by generic caution or fairness, allowing the check to pass without needing the hidden information.
